proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot distinguish global-load latency from shared-memory (reduction/staging) latency, and it has zero visibility into the store path's coalescing, so it misdiagnoses kernels whose real cost is block-reduction shared-memory traffic or uncoalesced writes.

rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_short_scoreboar: HIGH -> restructure the reduction to warp shuffles / more serial per-thread accumulation / fewer shared-memory round trips instead of optimizing global loads; LOW -> shared memory is innocent, keep focus on the global-memory path
rationale.smsp__sass_average_data_bytes_per_sector: LOW -> output writes are uncoalesced, stage output tiles in shared memory or re-index so warps write consecutive addresses; HIGH -> write path is fine, direct effort to load coalescing or reduction structure
